newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $4.87 bln for week of Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $4.87 bln for week of Oct 21.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $4.87 billion in 149 offerings for the week of Oct 21, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $2.35 billion in 88 offerings. The largest is a $712.6 million New Jersey Transportation Trust Fund issue on Oct 23.
Negotiated sales total $2.5 billion in 61 offerings. The largest issue is a $459 million New York City Transit Authority offering through Dillon Read & Co.
An additional nine negotiated deals totaling $277 million are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.
